items.name: Kostelec Nonstop Cubing 2023
items.information:
**This is a 24 hour competition!**
As such it won't be very newcomer and kid friendly, so please keep that in mind.

Make sure that you are active on your WCA email account. As a result of not doing so, your registration might get removed as we will very likely send you some important information regarding the competition and ask you to confirm that you will attend!
Please read carefully all the tabs, especially "judging"!

There is a competitor limit of 14 for multiBLD and 35 for FMC.

**Toto je 24 hodinová soutěž!**
Jako taková není nejvhodnější první soutěží, ani soutěží vhodnou pro mladší speedcubery, zvažte proto prosím pečlivě svou účast.

Ujistěte se, že email použitý při registraci na WCA opravdu používáte. Velmi pravděpodobně Vám pošleme důležité informace a budeme žádat o potvrzení účasti. Nebudete-li reagovat, Vaše registrace může být smazána!
Prosíme přečtěte si pozorně všechny záložky, obzvláště „judgování“!

Na multiBLD je limit 14 soutěžících a na FMC je limit 35 soutěžících.

items.name: Athens Winter Open 2023
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2N0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--83fc6c836b78e431cd8e0d013efd6be412a6e388/IMG_9500.JPG)
Athens Winter Open 2023 είναι ο πρώτος διαγωνισμός για φέτος στην Ελλάδα , ύστερα από μία πολλά υποσχόμενη χρονιά. Στις επόμενες διοργανώσεις, θα εστιάζουμε πάντα σε 2 διοργανώσεις που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστές στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε τα αγωνίσματα του 6x6 και του 7x7 πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο ελληνικό εθνικό πρωτάθλημα προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλες οι εκδηλώσεις θα είναι οικείες στους συμμετέχοντες.

Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μία ακόμα γιορτή για το cubing γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλώ διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείτε ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registrations στο site της wca και να γίνει η πληρωμή της εισόδου, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 


Athens Winter Open 2023 is the first competition this year in Greece, following a very successfull year of competitions.
In the next competitions, we will always focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we want to bring the events 6x6 and 7x7 closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all events will be familiar to the competitors.

Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing!

Please read the following tabs very carefully!

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the eca site and pay the fee as described in the nexts tabs.

items.name: Crazy Cubing Centurion 2023
items.information:
Kick off the 2023 cubing season in Gauteng with a two day competition in Centurion.


### VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial" to be held at the start of Sunday. If you are a new competitor who is competing in any events on Saturday, please speak to a delegate who will show you how to compete and perform the above duties.

We also recommend that you take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 


### SPONSOR

[CubeCo](https://cubeco.co.za/) is sponsoring this competition, and will be offering cubes for sale on the day. 


### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.name: Arrigorriaga Side Events 2023
items.information:
AVISO: Si eres nuevo, recomendamos acudir a una ['competición normal'](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmoreOpen2023) antes. Este open será un test para competiciones similares, en las que cada competidor realizará medias en los eventos que quiera en el orden que quiera. Para participar, a parte de registrarse en le WCA, es necesario rellenar el [siguiente formulario](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66), y asistir a los dos grupos, de inicio a fin. Más información en la pestaña de FUNCIONAMIENTO DE LA COMPETICIÓN.

OHARRA: Zure lehen lehiaketa bada, aurretik ['lehiaketa arrunt'](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmoreOpen2023) batera joatea gomendatzen dizugu. Open hau antzeko lehiaketetarako test bat izango da, lehiakide bakoitzak nahi dituen ekitaldietako batez bestekoak egingo ditu nahi duen ordenan. Parte hartzeko ezinbestekoa da [formulario hau](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66) betetzea, eta bi taldeetan egon, hasieratik amaierara. Informazio gehiago LEHIAKETAREN FUNTZIONAMENDUA erlaitzean.

WARNING: If you're a new competitor, we recommend you attend a ['normal' competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmoreOpen2023) first. This competition will be a test, in which each competitor will do their averages in the order they want. To participate at this competition, it is mandatory to fill out [this form](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66), and also attend both groups. More information at the HOW WILL THE COMPETITION WORK tab.
